player_intent: Slides and dives are committed evasive movement, never a firing stance.
acceptance_rule: Every slide and dive rejects firing for the full active mobility action on local, browser-client, and authoritative-server paths without consuming ammunition. The existing slide-to-crouch movement handoff remains unchanged; once movement resumes, the normal movement-spread owner opens the reticle and firing resumes only after the mobility action ends.

nodes.role: Exposes whether the canonical committed mobility state locks firing.
Rejects local canonical shots before ballistics or ammunition changes.
Rechecks authoritative operator mobility before server ballistics.

must_not_change: Normal crouch and slide handoff timing
visual_check: In res://main.tscn, begin every slide and dive while pressing fire. Confirm no muzzle flash, recoil, sound, tracer, or ammunition change; after the mobility action ends in crouch or prone, confirm the next fresh fire input works.

system_delta.reason: Consume the existing CharacterBody committed-action state in both shot paths; do not create a second timer or animation owner.

candidate.system: CharacterBody-owned mobility lock consumed by local and server shots
